practicalCriteria: The report records the steps taken to make the area safe and get help, in order, before other content
Facts are written as observed events, and each opinion is marked as opinion
Each witness has their agreement to be contacted recorded, and each notification records who, when and how
Each follow-up action has an owner and a due date, and a closed date is recorded only with a check
passRule: assessor sign-off against rubric; no quiz pass
evidenceRequired: photographs or diagrams with who took them and when
stopWorkCriteria: Stop work and make the area safe first when anyone may be at risk
Do not complete the report before first aid or emergency help has been arranged where someone may be hurt
